title: Offline partition log with recovery and integrity
text: Design an offline educational system around durable append records, deterministic partitions, offset transactions, atomic compaction, crash recovery, snapshot integrity, and read-only audit. The task must be independently implemented and must not copy upstream code.

stages.title: Framed append log
stages.instruction: Implement a durable framed append log with checksums, recovery, stable offsets, and non-mutating invalid writes.

stages.title: Consumer offsets
stages.instruction: Implement transactional consumer offsets with monotonic commits, generations, canonical persistence, and strict group validation.

stages.title: Partitioned topics
stages.instruction: Implement immutable topic metadata, deterministic SHA-256 key partitioning, merged reads, and strict partition bounds.

mutant.name: shift_partition
mutant.deterministic_fault: shift the correct SHA-256 partition by one modulo partition count

stages.title: Retention and compaction
stages.instruction: Implement atomic retention and key compaction while preserving logical offsets and recovering interrupted rewrites safely.

mutant.name: renumber_after_compaction
mutant.deterministic_fault: rewrite surviving records with contiguous offsets from zero

stages.title: Snapshot integrity
stages.instruction: Implement deterministic snapshots, integrity manifests, atomic restore, and read-only reporting for missing or malformed partitions.

mutant.name: audit_always_clean
mutant.deterministic_fault: return an empty error list for every snapshot
